correctness.rationale: For the explicit triangle and axis point family, perpendicular projection gives exact pedal vertices, from which the circumradius and inradius formulas follow. At \(y=1/100\) the conjectured inequality reverses; positivity is certified by the strict rational comparisons \(140^2<2\cdot99^2\), \(1118^2<50005\cdot25\), and \(6853560/495>13745\). Continuity of the closed formulas yields an interval of interior violations.
